synth.notes:
Two axes: row band R (visible gray mirror r->2R-r) and column strip C (mirror across C and across both = invisible erasers: -1 ring, centre shows lower solid).
New mechanic for step 268: a piece occupying the C column has its R-reflection rendered invisible too (whole piece); global counter is a red herring (never changes).
A5 cycles C -> R -> pieces sorted by bbox (x,y) -> C; selection read from 0 centres; A1/A2 move C or piece in x, A3/A4 move R or piece in y; pieces blocked by bounds/other pieces, axes pass under pieces.
Frame rendered per 3x3 block layer stack and re-extracted: wall/player = 4-conn comps of own colour plus all 0 cells ranked by bbox (x,y); reflections ranked over visible+invisible cells; targets merged at bbox gap <=4.
Stateless (no hidden state). Unconfirmed: whether a piece on the R row similarly changes reflection visibility; ablating the new rule fails only step 268.
